propositions: Interrupted retirement operations where a binding remains both live and tombstoned must be classified and completed without automatic invocation.
Retirement completion removes redundant live forward/reverse entry pairs while retaining the tombstone when all three (tombstone, forward, reverse) agree on exact local id and Jira key.
Recovery completion is idempotent (repeated completion performs no write) and aborts safely with evidence retention on identity mismatch, corrupt files, or replace failures.
Keyed pending recovery performs no search; keyless pending recovery enforces three-miss plus 3600-second grace requirements and continues despite individual entry failures.
Create recovery extraction into binding_recovery.py maintains existing behavior and invocation gate (`if not scoped_ids`) unchanged; no new write-bearing conditions are introduced.
